critical_code_review_comments: Retention module is clean and well-implemented. No issues found.
Summary stats correctly computed from unfiltered set even when window/status filter is applied — correct behavior.
rowBorderColor() uses red for <=30 days AND expired (days<0), amber for <=90, teal for <=180 — matches spec.
Sidebar badge correctly sums expiring_90_days + already_expired from summary.
Create Case modal fetches original case via GET /api/cases/{id} to retrieve client_id before creating — minor extra network call but functionally correct.
handleCreateCase: on success navigates to new case and sets retention_status to new_case_created — correct flow.
